Subject: Re: v4a deploy — sudden p99 latency + 5xx wave

Hi Nikhil,

We flipped to your v4a model + new int8 profile around 19:00 PDT and immediately saw:
- p95/p99 jump across the board (p99 from ~480ms -> 2.3s)
- a 7% 5xx rate concentrated on long prompts (>800 tokens)
- throughput dropped ~30% on hot paths (checkout flow)

Attached a perf extract and truncated logs. This is blocking our checkout traffic — customers are reporting timeouts and declined transactions.

Can you confirm if this is expected behavior for v4a/INT8? We rolled back as a stopgap but would like to understand root cause and a mitigation plan.

Attachments: perf-sample-20260917.csv, service-logs-20260917.txt

Thanks,
Eric
Eric Wang

Quick triage summary (initial):
- Reproduced a latency cliff on long sequences when particular attention-kernel fallback occurs after quantized matmul on GPU family A100-80GB with the new int8 kernels. The fallback path increases kernel launches and serializes some ops.
- Error pattern (5xx) appears to be a downstream timeout triggered by longer decode loops + retry logic in PaperTrail's edge proxy. Not intrinsic hallucination/quality issue.

Attachments: rollback-playbook-v1.pdf (emergency rollback steps), perf-sample-20260917.csv (annotated)

Immediate recommended actions:
1) Ask affected customers (PaperTrail) to stay on v3.9-int8 for now (they already rolled back).
2) Pause the v4a int8 profile rollout for other Tier 1 customers — run a targeted canary on smaller instance fleets and capture kernel traces.
3) Engineering to prepare a micro-patch that reduces kernel-fallback triggers (ETA 48h); if not possible, plan to ship a safer fp16 profile.

I'll open INF-7219 and attach kernel traces + perf CSVs. If we need an across-customer rollback, we need Marissa's sign-off for an emergency change + credit for impacted accounts.

— Ben Carter
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: v4a deploy — sudden p99 latency + 5xx wave

Eric — thank you for the patience and the quick rollback. Summary and next steps:

Summary:
- Root cause: kernel-fallback path triggered by int8 matmul edge-case on A100 flavor causing longer decode loops and cascading timeouts in your proxy.
- Impact: increased p99 (up to 5x in the worst traces) and a transient 5xx spike tied to hot-path long prompts.

Actions we are taking (timeline):
- Stop: immediate pause of v4a int8 rollout to Tier 1 customers (COMPLETE).
- Mitigation: Ben's team will ship a micro-patch to reduce fallback triggers (48h ETA). If that misses, we'll produce an fp16 profile as a safer alternate (72h ETA).
- Remediation: backlog clean-up assistance from our support team — Monica will coordinate retries and mitigation with you.
- Business: I'm escalating to Marissa and the commercial team to evaluate pro-rated credits for impacted window.

Docs/links: INF-7219 (Jira) — Ben attached kernel traces and rollback-playbook-v1.pdf.

Can we schedule a 30m postmortem with your SREs and our runtime team tomorrow at 10:00 PDT? If that works, Monica will send the invite.

Appreciate the fast rollback — we'll follow up with a technical RCA and a proposed credit.

— Nikhil Sharma
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
